summary: The filing is an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events, reporting that StratCap Digital Infrastructure REIT's board approved an updated quarterly estimated NAV per share/unit as of June 30, 2026. The NAV figures are provided for each share class (e.g., Class A $9.6225, Class I $9.6357) and partnership units. This is a routine non-event regulatory update on asset valuation, not a special situation. No transaction, activist, or strategic change is involved. Nothing to watch or arbitrage; it is a standard periodic disclosure.
